title: sse: fix partial JSON streaming delimiter and token/event ordering issues
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Fixes several corner cases in the SSE streaming layer that produced unparsable partial JSON payloads and out-of-order token/event emission under high concurrency. Motivation: customers observed intermittent failures when streaming structured JSON responses (function/tool calling and OpenAI compatibility flows) where partial chunks would contain delimiter tokens in the wrong order or the final `}

` boundary was emitted before the associated `event: token` pieces, leading client-side JSON parsers to fail and SDK reconnection logic to mis-handle resumptions. This PR: 1) Reworks the SSE framing buffer to ensure delimiter tokens (partial-json-left/right markers) are always emitted before/after token/event fragments according to the documented protocol; 2) Adds an event sequencer that guarantees emit-order is consistent with logical token order across batching and KV cache rewinds; 3) Adds a small backpressure window on the HTTP stream writer so that flush ordering cannot be inverted by concurrent goroutines; 4) Updates the OpenAI-compat streaming adapter to tolerate a small set of delimiter reorderings for older clients while we roll out stricter framing; 5) Adds unit and integration tests that exercise concurrent streaming, tool-calling structured outputs, and partial-JSON edge cases; 6) Updates changelog and adds a short compatibility note. Checklist:
- [x] Kernel-level framing changes implemented
- [x] Sequencer and ordering tests added
- [x] OpenAI compat adapter update and defensive parsing
- [x] Perf microbenchmark (no regression)
- [x] Release notes updated
References: ENG-8123 (streaming stability), ENG-8301 (sse partial-json), related: PR #81342 (previous attempt to stabilize streaming).

ci_summary: CI initially failed on a flaky test (TestStreamReorder under macOS runners). Reproduced locally, fixed race by adding a lightweight mutex around writer flush. Re-run all checks: build OK, unit tests OK, integration tests OK, linters OK. Final CI: all green (9/9).
release_notes: Fix: stable SSE streaming framing for partial JSON and structured outputs. Addresses intermittent client-side JSON parse failures when streaming function-call / structured output payloads. No breaking changes; older SDKs are tolerated via openai-compat adapter fallback.
notes_for_ops: Recommend rolling restart of frontends that perform streaming (redwood-gateway, redwood-proxy) after deployment to pick up writer flush semantics. Monitor sse.partial_json_errors and sse.stream_retries for 24h post-deploy.
